{{Top|leg}}
'''Vectron''' was a company that produced [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the conflict, they were considering producing a line of vehicles exclusively for one faction, but were convinced otherwise.
